aspect: Verification requires an institution that still exists
description: Credential evaluators write to the issuing university for confirmation. Where the university has been destroyed or its records lost, there is no one to answer, and an unanswered verification is treated as a failed one.
energy_note: Your degree is real and unconfirmable.

description: West Bank and Jordanian universities have tried to give displaced students final-exam access to complete degrees, but differences between curricula complicate transfer, so partial study frequently converts into nothing.
energy_note: Three years of study that count for nothing anywhere.

description: Re-sitting professional examinations abroad in a second language, while working, takes years that arrive exactly when a career would otherwise be compounding.

aspect: Which pushes qualified people into unqualified work
description: The pharmacist drives, the engineer delivers, the teacher cleans - for the years the recognition takes, and often permanently, because the years themselves close the door.
money_note: Lifetime earnings difference from downgraded work.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the Irish appeal that cannot be posted
description: Irish authorities require study-visa appeals to be submitted by post with original documents. There is no internationally recognised postal service in Gaza. The appeal route formally exists and cannot be used by the people it applies to.
energy_note: Appeal by post, from a place with no post.
